{{Quote|Where so much can happen with so very little effort.|Vox|<ref name="GTLAAp" />}}
'''Ord Mynock''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mynockra system]]<ref name="GTLAAp" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was originally settled during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] as a communication relay. As trade lanes shifted elsewhere, the planet fell into relative obscurity.

It was a lush world, but very dangerous. Most of the flora and fauna were hostile and deadly. They include vicious crushing vines and hover-vehicle-eating [[Plant/Legends|plants]]. There was also the threat of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Ord Mynock was believed to be the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Mynock/Legends|Mynocks]].<ref name="EGASp">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

[[ComNet Corporation]] was based in the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]] on Ord Mynock.<ref name="GTLAAp" />
